title: Illumina Library Preparation for Scapharca broughtonii
author: Chang-Ming CM Bai
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.z75f9q6
materials: NEBNext® Ultra™ II Q5® Master Mix

Repaired using NEBNext® End Prep Enzyme Mix (NEB, E6091) and NEBNext® End Repair Reaction Buffer (NEB, B6052) keeped at 20℃, 30min; 65℃, 30min with the end-repaired fragments to obtain blunt ends which were then 3’-adenlyated to create sticky ends.

PCR was performed using NEBNext® Ultra™ II Q5® Master Mix (NEB, M0544), and the Index i7 and Universal i5 preimers. The temperature profile was 30 sec. at 98 ℃ followed by 10 cycles of 10 sec. at 98 ℃, 75 sec. at 65 ℃, and more 5 min. at 65 ℃ for further elongation. INDEX i7 PRIMER: 5´-CAA GCA GAA GAC GGC ATA CGA GAT ATGACGTC GTG ACT GGA GTT CAG ACG TGT GCT CTT CCG ATC*T-3´ NEBNext Universal i5 PCR Primer：5´-AAT GAT ACG GCG ACC ACC GAG ATC TAC ACT CTT TCC CTA CAC GAC GCT CTT CCG ATC*T-3´

steps.title: Shear extracted DNA
steps.instruction: Shear the extracted DNA into fragments of approximately 350 bp using a Bioruptor Pico Sonication System (Diagenode, Seraing, Belgium).

substeps.instruction: Verify fragment sizes via agarose gel electrophoresis to ensure main fragments are between 200 bp and 500 bp.

steps.title: Purify DNA fragments
steps.instruction: Purify DNA fragments with a size > 300 bp using VAHTSTM DNA Clean Beads (Vazyme Biotech Co., Ltd, Nanjing, China).

steps.title: Ligate and amplify adapters
steps.instruction: Ligate T-tailed adapters to both ends of the DNA fragments and perform amplification.

steps.title: Purify PCR product
steps.instruction: Purify the resulting PCR production using VAHTSTM DNA Clean Beads (Vazyme Biotech Co., Ltd, Nanjing, China).
